user.title: FoxESS Local
user.description: Runs a local server that the FoxESS Wi-Fi logger connects to instead of the cloud. Point the logger's cloud IP (8.209.116.72:14431) at this Home Assistant host with a gateway Dest-NAT rule.

data.port: Listen port (must match the Dest-NAT target; default 14431)
